candidate.rationale: The ToOwned trait already specifies ensures res.deep_view() == self.deep_view(), so adding the same postcondition at this impl is redundant and triggers the 'already_specified_via_trait' anti‑vacuity result. The Verus/harness errors (missing HashMap import, private module visibility) are harness-generation issues unrelated to a stronger impl-level postcondition.
risks: Duplicating the trait postcondition can cause specification conflicts or redundant checks in the harness.
Soundness still depends on correctness of DeepView/DeepViewClone for K and V (e.g., deep_clone must not introduce key collisions).
Harness generation errors (private module, missing imports) must be fixed separately before attempting new impl-level specs.
